items.title: Ran Blake interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 16, 2021
items.q: I would curtail it to Jeanne. And there are things she’s done. I’m still horrified, I think one of the best things we did is our first album, “Laura.”

ctx.x: Okay. So you came out and you didn’t have any music, which is not that surprising, but at some point in the song you are looking at her waiting for her to hit a note, and I’ve done some accompanying, and so in my head I’m wondering does Ran know what note she’s about to sing and is it guiding his chord or whatever, choice, what he’s about to play?

Often it does. Often I can predict what she’s going to produce, her tone, her beautiful, dark, velvet voice. But there are other times I’m just flabbergasted. I’m thrilled by a note she will come up with. And I think, I don’t really scrutinize my — I probably, one part of the sound that I had in my head might come but I would curtail it to Jeanne. And there are things she’s done. I’m still horrified, I think one of the best things we did is our first album, “Laura.” But there’s one time where I play a chord very…
surprise me, to get back to your — so I’m only able to predict occasionally. And I’m not sure I’m consciously thinking of this. There must be something in me that does.
